tagline.en: VMem — an interactive world model with surfel-indexed memory, so navigable video stays consistent as you explore.
tagline.zh: VMem——带 surfel 索引记忆的交互式世界模型，让可导航视频在你探索时保持一致。

en: VMem is an interactive video world model that generates a scene you can move through. Its key idea is memory: it maintains a geometry-indexed record of what it has already rendered, so as you navigate the world stays consistent instead of drifting or forgetting earlier views.

It streams video frame by frame in response to camera motion, making it suited to interactive exploration rather than fixed clips. Under the hood it pairs a Stable Diffusion 2.1 backbone with a CLIP image encoder and DUSt3R/CUT3R-style geometry for its spatial memory.
In WorldFoundry the VMem runtime is built in-tree, so you can run the navigation experience with staged VMem and CUT3R checkpoints and no external checkout.
zh: VMem 是一个可交互的视频世界模型，能生成你可以在其中穿行的场景。它的核心是记忆：维护一份以几何为索引的、对已渲染内容的记录，因此你导航时世界会保持一致，而不会漂移或遗忘先前的视角。
它随相机运动逐帧流式生成视频，因而适合交互式探索，而非固定片段。其内部将 Stable Diffusion 2.1 主干与 CLIP 图像编码器，以及 DUSt3R/CUT3R 风格的几何结合起来，构成空间记忆。
在 WorldFoundry 中，VMem 运行时内置于代码树中，你只需准备好 VMem 与 CUT3R 的 checkpoint，无需外部代码即可运行导航体验。

whenToUse.en: Use VMem when you want to explore a generated scene interactively and need earlier views to stay consistent as the camera moves — its memory is built for that.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想交互式地探索一个生成场景，并希望相机移动时先前的视角保持一致时，选择 VMem——它的记忆机制正为此而生。

notFor.en: Not aimed at one-shot text-to-video; it needs several staged checkpoints (VMem, CUT3R, and the diffusion/CLIP backbones) and is driven by camera navigation.
notFor.zh: 不面向一次性文生视频；它需要准备多个 checkpoint（VMem、CUT3R 以及扩散/CLIP 主干），并由相机导航驱动。

en: Geometry-indexed memory keeps views consistent over time
Streams frames in response to camera motion
Built on Stable Diffusion 2.1 with CLIP and CUT3R/DUSt3R geometry
zh: 可交互、可导航的视频世界模型
以几何为索引的记忆让视角随时间保持一致
随相机运动流式生成帧
基于 Stable Diffusion 2.1，结合 CLIP 与 CUT3R/DUSt3R 几何
